plan: Three illustrated routines (wash hands, brush teeth, go to bed) with big tap and drag steps, bubbles and voiced praise; meal choices and a daily routine chart are left out.
A friend beside a window with four weathers (rain, snow, sun, wind) and 16 clothing pieces dragged on, with a happy or chilly reaction; temperature numbers and seasons calendar are left out.
30 everyday objects dragged into paper, glass and metal bins marked with symbols, over 6 rounds with voiced names and gentle retries; compost, local rules and scoring are left out.
One garden scene with 12 real bird species that come and go, a camera view where a tap takes a photo, and a field guide that fills with voiced names and calls; other habitats and rarity are left out.
A calm sea where tapping floating litter scoops it into a soft net while fish and turtles swim free, over 8 short bays with voiced facts; boats, upgrades and timers are left out.
16 garden maps where a drawn line sends the bee from hive to flowers and back, with flowers turning to fruit once pollinated; nectar budgets and competing insects are left out.
A vet station with 6 animal patients and one or two big treatment steps each (bandage, brush, drink, rest), all drag or tap, with happy recoveries; diagnosis choices and a clinic sim are left out.
One home with a link pet showing 6 moods and needs (water, food, rest, play), tap and drag care actions, a day and night cycle and a decoratable corner; mini-games and visiting friends are left out.
A cutaway planter where water, light and soil choices visibly grow roots and shoots of 6 plants over accelerated days, plus 8 grow-this goals; pests and a full garden layout are left out.
One shared kitchen with 8 recipes made by measuring, chopping and stirring with marked cups and voiced steps, ending in a shared meal; time pressure and co-op multiplayer are left out.
A small farm with 8 crop beds, 6 crops, compost and four seasons where rotation keeps soil healthy, tap-to-walk movement and a seasonal goal list; villagers, animals and festivals are left out.

One continent map where a flock route is drawn between wetlands and rest stops, then flies through the seasons with energy shown, over 12 species journeys; weather events and other continents are left out.
One cutaway aquarium with 8 fish, 6 plants and filters where oxygen and nitrogen gauges respond to choices, plus 10 balance goals; breeding, diseases and multiple tanks are left out.
One community woodland grid where paths, firebreaks and planting shape tree growth, wildlife and fire risk over seasons, with 10 scenarios; villagers voting on commons and campaigns are left out.
10 muddy scenes cleaned by dragging a water jet to reveal bright mosaics, with a visible water gauge and a refill tap; tools upgrades and timed challenges are left out.

One planted terrarium with 12 real invertebrates hiding under leaves and stones, tap to reveal and photograph, and a field journal to place observations with voiced facts; care needs and more habitats are left out.
A dock with a magnet on a line lowered by tap or drag to lift metal litter while fish swim past, over 8 ponds, sorting catches into metal and non-metal; rods upgrades and timers are left out.
